title: Translational nanorobotics breaking through biological membranes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00483C, Review Article
Alzbeta Ressnerova, Zbynek Heger, Martin Pumera
Within the landscape of the human body, biological membranes stand as critical barriers in the successful delivery of therapeutic cargo to the target site. Their crossing is a pivotal criterion for the clinical success of nanorobotics.
